label: Some actual concrete being is at the MIRROR_2 image only if it keeps the actual handedness
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: a chiral individual, local to the CPT image (MIRROR_2). Some concrete being x exists at w, and if x exists at the CPT image τ.image w then H (global handedness) has the same value there as at w. It says nothing about any other world. Given reversed handedness at the CPT image it is equivalent to x's absence from that image, and that absence implies it. Example: an actual molecule of one enantiomer, if being of its chemical kind is essential to it and its only candidate at the CPT image is its CPT counterpart, an antimatter molecule of the other handedness and so of another kind (sortal essentialism with enantiomers as distinct kinds); the example supports the absence, hence this premise, and does not support the global form 'x exists only at worlds with the actual handedness', which is not used. A haecceitist who holds that the same molecule exists, mirrored, at the CPT image denies it.
